query:
SELECT attendeeId, firstName, lastName, company 
FROM delegateProfiles 
WHERE firstName LIKE '%Lucy%' OR lastName LIKE '%Bousfield%' 
   OR firstName LIKE '%Joanna%' OR lastName LIKE '%Hackett%'
LIMIT 10;
